top_signals.title: Cooking Gas Reveals Extent of Iran War Energy Shock
top_signals.summary:
The Iran war has transformed how cooking gas reaches millions across Asia and Africa. India has kept LPG flowing by redrawing supply routes and boosting domestic output, but the disruption has come at a cost. Akriti Sharma explains.
 (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
